events.title: Bhayangkara vs Persik Kediri
events.dataContent:
Bhayangkara vs. Persik Kediri: Indonesian Liga 1 Live Stream

On Friday morning, September 19, 2025, at 08:30 UTC (11:30 MSK / 15:30 local time), an interesting match of the 6th round of the Indonesian Liga 1 will take place. Bhayangkara FC will host Persik Kediri. Tutsport.net will provide a live video broadcast of this encounter.

Pre-Match Analysis

Bhayangkara

After a poor start to the season, Bhayangkara has begun to gain momentum. The team is in 11th place in the league table with 5 points. The "Guardians" are unbeaten and have not conceded a goal in their last two matches, in which they earned four points by defeating Persis Solo (2-0) and drawing with Madura United (0-0). Paul Munster's side seems to have found its defensive rhythm and will be looking to build on their success in this home game.

Persik Kediri

Persik Kediri is also on the rise. The "White Tigers" are in seventh place with 7 points and come into the match with a two-game winning streak. The team has shown good productivity in attack, scoring four goals in their last two games. The away match against an in-form opponent will be a major test of their ambitions.

Head-to-Head History

The history of encounters between these two teams includes six matches, with a slight advantage for Persik, who have three wins to Bhayangkara's two, with one match ending in a draw. However, the most recent meeting between the teams in April 2024 ended in a sensational and comprehensive 7-0 victory for Bhayangkara.

Bhayangkara vs. Persik Kediri Match Prediction

A very even and unpredictable match is expected. Both teams are in good form. Bhayangkara will have the home-field advantage and confidence after two clean sheets, while Persik possesses a more potent attack. Given the contradictory history of their meetings and their current form, a draw seems a very likely outcome.
Our prediction: Draw.

events.title: Persebaya Surabaya vs Semen Padang
events.dataContent:

On Friday afternoon, September 19, 2025, at 12:00 UTC (15:00 MSK / 19:00 local time), a 6th-round match of the Indonesian Liga 1 will take place at the Gelora Bung Tomo Stadium in Surabaya. Local side Persebaya will host the newly-promoted team, Semen Padang. Tutsport.net will provide a live video broadcast of this encounter.

Persebaya Surabaya

Persebaya has had an inconsistent start to the current season. After five rounds, the team is in 11th place in the league table with 5 points. "Bajul Ijo" (The Green Crocodiles) have secured only one victory, with two draws and two defeats. In their last outing, Persebaya lost the "Clasico" 3-1 away to Persib. The home match against a newcomer to the league is an excellent opportunity to bounce back from recent setbacks and please their fans.

Semen Padang

Semen Padang, who have returned to the top flight, are yet to secure their first victory. The team is in 14th place with 4 points, which they have earned from four draws in five matches. In their last match, "Kerbau Sirah" (The Fighting Buffaloes) drew 1-1 at home against PSBS Biak. The team has shown a resilient character, but this has not yet been enough to secure a win.

Head-to-Head History

The history of encounters between these two teams includes only two matches, both of which took place in 2019. Persebaya won both of these meetings convincingly, scoring a total of seven goals against Semen Padang.

Persebaya Surabaya vs. Semen Padang Match Prediction

Persebaya is the favorite in this home match. Despite their less-than-ideal start to the season, the quality of the Surabaya side is higher than that of the league newcomers. The home-field advantage and the head-to-head record also favor the hosts.
Our prediction: Persebaya to win.

events.title: AGMK vs Bunyodkor
events.dataContent:
AGMK (Olmaliq) vs. Bunyodkor (Tashkent): Uzbekistan Super League Live Stream

On Friday afternoon, September 19, 2025, at 13:30 UTC (16:30 MSK / 18:30 local time), a 22nd-round match of the Uzbekistan Super League will take place at the AGMK Stadium in Olmaliq. Local side AGMK will host Bunyodkor from Tashkent. Tutsport.net will provide a live video broadcast of this encounter.

Pre-Match Analysis

AGMK (Olmaliq)

AGMK, boasting one of the strongest squads in the league, is competing for medals and a spot in Asian continental competitions. The team is in 4th place in the table, still in with a chance of finishing in the top three. The club from Olmaliq is in good form, having lost only once in their last six matches. In the last round, AGMK secured a convincing away victory over Sogdiana. In a home match against an underdog, the team will be aiming for nothing less than a victory to continue their pursuit of the leaders.

Bunyodkor (Tashkent)

Bunyodkor, once a flagship of Uzbek football, is having a very poor season. The "Swallows" are in the relegation zone, in 14th place in the league table. The team comes into the match in low spirits, having lost three of their last five league games. In their last outing, Bunyodkor lost at home to the league's bottom team, Xorazm. The trip to face one of the league leaders will be a major test for the Tashkent side.

Head-to-Head History

The history of encounters between these two teams includes 33 matches and is very balanced: 13 wins for Bunyodkor, 11 for AGMK, and 9 draws. However, in recent meetings, the advantage has been with AGMK. The first-leg match in April of this year ended in a 0-0 draw.

AGMK vs. Bunyodkor Match Prediction

This match has a clear favorite. AGMK is competing for medals, is in excellent form, and is playing at home. Bunyodkor, on the other hand, is in a deep crisis. The massive difference in current form and tournament motivation leaves the visitors with virtually no chance.
Our prediction: AGMK to win.

The team is in magnificent form, with a seven-match unbeaten streak. In their last match, Beşiktaş drew 1-1 in a derby against İstanbul Başakşehir. In the game against the league newcomers, Beşiktaş will be aiming for nothing less than a victory to continue their title race.

The history of encounters between these two teams shows a significant advantage for Beşiktaş. The Istanbul club has won 7 of the last 9 head-to-head meetings. Although Göztepe is a tough opponent on their home ground, Beşiktaş is the favorite in this match. Their superior class, excellent form, and dominant head-to-head record all favor the Istanbul giants.

events.dataContent:

Al-Ahli (Jeddah)

Al-Ahli, under the management of Matthias Jaissle, has had a magnificent start to the new season. The "Royal" club is in third place in the league table, having not suffered a single defeat. They have collected 10 points from four rounds (three wins, one draw). In their last match, Al-Ahli started their AFC Champions League campaign with a victory over Nasaf. The team, led by stars like Riyad Mahrez and Roberto Firmino, will be looking to inflict the first defeat on the champions and prove their own title credentials.

Al-Hilal, the reigning champions, continues its dominance. Jorge Jesus's side leads the league table, also unbeaten. The "Leaders" have secured three wins and one draw. Al-Hilal boasts the most powerful squad in Asia, including players like Neymar and Aleksandar Mitrović, and comes into the derby in excellent form. In the match against a direct competitor, Al-Hilal will be aiming for nothing less than a victory to solidify their lead.

The history of encounters between these two teams in recent years has favored Al-Hilal. The club from Riyadh has won four of the last six head-to-head meetings. Last season, Al-Hilal defeated Al-Ahli twice in the league, including a 2-1 victory in Jeddah.

Al-Ahli vs. Al-Hilal Match Prediction

An incredibly tense and spectacular match is expected between the two best teams in Saudi Arabia. Both sides are in excellent form and are packed with world-class stars. Al-Ahli will have the home-field advantage, but Al-Hilal looks slightly more consistent and has the upper hand in head-to-head encounters. Given the attacking potential of both teams, it is likely that fans will see goals from both sides.

events.title: Stuttgart vs St. Pauli
events.dataContent:
Stuttgart vs. St. Pauli: Bundesliga Live Stream

On Friday evening, September 19, 2025, at 18:30 UTC (21:30 MSK / 20:30 local time), the opening match of the fourth round of the German Bundesliga will take place at the MHP-Arena in Stuttgart. Local side VfB Stuttgart will host the newly-promoted FC St. Pauli. Both teams have had an excellent start to the season and are in the upper part of the table. Tutsport.net will provide a live video broadcast of this encounter.

Pre-Match Analysis

Stuttgart

Stuttgart, under the management of Sebastian Hoeneß, has had a magnificent start to the new season. The "Swabians" are in fourth place in the league table, having not suffered a single defeat (two wins, one draw). In their last outing, Stuttgart drew 1-1 away against SC Freiburg. The team is playing very high-scoring football, having scored 8 goals in three rounds. The team's star striker, Serhou Guirassy, has continued his goal-scoring form from last season. In a home match, Stuttgart will be looking to extend its unbeaten streak.

St. Pauli

St. Pauli, who have returned to the Bundesliga after a 13-year absence, has been one of the revelations of the start of the season. The "Pirates" are in sixth place with 6 points, having secured two victories and suffered only one defeat. In their last match, the team confidently defeated FC Köln 2-0 at home. Fabian Hürzeler's side plays a bold style of football and will be looking to challenge one of the league leaders on their home turf.

Head-to-Head History

The history of encounters between these two teams includes 11 matches. The advantage lies with Stuttgart, who have won 7 times, while St. Pauli has been victorious only twice. Stuttgart has won the last three consecutive head-to-head meetings. The last time the teams met was in the 2019/20 season in the 2. Bundesliga, where the "Swabians" were stronger in both games.

Stuttgart vs. St. Pauli Match Prediction

Despite St. Pauli's strong start, Stuttgart is the favorite in this match. The home-field advantage, a higher class of players, and the head-to-head record all favor the "Swabians." An interesting match is expected between two attacking teams, in which both sides are likely to score.
Our prediction: Stuttgart to win and Both Teams to Score - Yes.
